args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for round_money per FIN-212

round_money was documented as banker's rounding but implemented
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test failures in
tests/test_money.py (2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to 2.67 instead of the expected 2.66.

## Changes
- Use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in the `quantize` call in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
